technique_name: Summarize the timeline of important events leading to World War II.
description: World War II began in September 1939 when Germany invaded Poland. In April 1940, Germany invaded Scandinavia and then France in May. Germany then launched a major campaign against the Soviet Union in June 1941. In December 1941, Japan attacked the United States at Pearl Harbor, and the United States declared war on Japan the next day. In retaliation, Germany and Italy declared war against the United States.
